systems.name: RiverPOS
systems.authoritative_responsibility: Store sales transactions and in-store returns
known_limitations: Cross-channel history depends on connected systems

systems.name: RiverStock
systems.authoritative_responsibility: SKU records, location stock, adjustments, and transfers

systems.name: RiverCommerce
systems.authoritative_responsibility: Online orders, cancellations, and online returns
known_limitations: Store inventory impact depends on a connector

systems.name: RiverBooks
known_limitations: Operational detail is available primarily through exports

systems.name: RiverSchedule
systems.authoritative_responsibility: Store labor schedules and staffing assignments
known_limitations: Not an authority for sales or inventory

systems.name: RiverBI
systems.authoritative_responsibility: Configured management reports and report delivery

systems.name: RiverFlow
known_limitations: No general-purpose application or reconciliation engine
